description: Channel is polymorphic on `channelName` (DirectLineChannel, WebChatChannel, SlackChannel, ...); the converted model keeps only the base members, so S.Struct strips the channel-specific `properties` payload (sites, app credentials, ...) on encode and decode. Add it as an untyped document on both the input and output shapes.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Channel-specific properties (polymorphic on `channelName`), e.g. `{ sites: [...] }` for DirectLineChannel/WebChatChannel.
